setEffects.4: The equipping character gains 1 Starspark when they use an Elemental Skill, Elemental Burst, or perform a Normal Attack. Up to 2 Starsparks can be held at once. The equipping character gains Undying Radiance while holding at least 1 Starspark. This effect increases the CRIT Rate of their <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> by 20%, with an additional 20% CRIT Rate if that DMG is Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. The equipping character loses 1 Starspark every 3s while on the field. Undying Radiance ends when all Starsparks are extinguished.

flower.name: Flower of the Epochal Advent
flower.desc: The high heavens bestowed an everlasting flower on their envoy, and greed was born of a life without end.
